text:
fiona: Quick sync note from Acme: they want a single purchase experience that bundles a marketplace commit credit with a per-device rebate and a simple renewal/rollover rule. Can we outline an ops-safe playbook?

omar: TL;DR: two main technical paths: (1) checkout-applied credit + rebate line-item, or (2) post-bill reconciliation. Checkout is better for conversion; reconciliation is lower ops work.

luke-sales: Sales preference = checkout applied. We need an "effective price" calc visible on SKU page and a 1-pager with 3 canned examples for sellers. Also request a short script for renewals: how credits apply if a customer signs a new annual contract.

pris-pricing: Pricing ops constraints: marketplace transaction fees matter. Recommend partners co-fund gross credit (customer sees full discount) and we record partner settlement net of fees. Floor rule: net to Redwood should not fall below 11% after fees + rebate.

gwen-legal: Legal asks: cap total rebate per account/year, require device proof (serials/manifest), include a 12-month clawback for fraud, and a 60-day dispute window after quarterly settlement. Also must avoid implying auto-extension on renewal.

acme-ops: Acme can accept a gross co-fund model and will supply serial exports. They prefer credits applied at checkout and rebates paid quarterly automatically once serials are validated. They can also set a quarterly co-fund cap.

pris-pricing: Ops questions: expiry length? I suggest 6 months for marketplace promo credits and 9 months for device rebates. Unused credits at expiry convert to a one-time account credit (no cash payout).

omar: Implementation detail for checkout flow: we need SKU-level metadata: marketplace_sku_id, partner_sku_id, credit_usd, expiry_days. Also a partner webhook for consumed-credit events for reconciliation. Estimate: spike + 3 sprints for full checkout across NA/EU, canary in NA.

luke-sales: For field simplicity, gate Growth/Enterprise tiers to manual partner-ops approval and keep Starter self-serve. Sales wants a simple UI toggle in CPQ for "Apply Acme bundle" that pulls in the credit lines.

gwen-legal: Also require a clawback clause if serial verification fails within 12 months and language that remaining credits may be applied to the first invoice of a new contract but do not extend the contract term.

acme-ops: Regarding telemetry/counters: Acme requests aggregated daily consumption + used-credit numbers for reconciliation. Per-customer details only under NDA.

pris-pricing: I'll prepare SKU mapping CSV template and a sample floor calc by Wed. CSV fields: marketplace_sku, partner_sku, credit_usd, expiry_days, tier

omar: I'll open GH RFC for private-offer extension: optional rebate_lines and partner_recon_webhook.

luke-sales: Sales deliverable: 1-pager + 3 example deal calc (SMB, mid-market, enterprise). I'll draft and drop by Tue.

gwen-legal: I'll circulate appendix draft with caps, evidence requirements, clawback, and dispute flow by Thu.

fiona: Good. Tentative timeline: if SKU CSV + caps finalize by Fri, partner-eng will schedule spike next week and aim for a soft launch in ~6 weeks. Otherwise push announcement.

ops-bot: Meeting created: "Acme bundle ops playbook" Fri 09:30 PT, 30m. Invite sent to participants. :calendar:
